name: Velanthra Companion Chassis Evening Set
description: A floor-length column gown in deep aubergine mirrorsilk, cut with asymmetric shoulder geometry for synthetic torso ratios and a cascading back split that accommodates spinal-length variation up to 40cm beyond human standard. Bioluminescent thread traces the seams in a slow pulse — warm amber that brightens with movement. A coordinating shoulder drape in sheer voile attaches via magnetic clasps, easily removed. Designed to be beautiful in a way that makes the chassis part of the aesthetic.
functionality: Adjustable spinal-length back split, magnetic-detach shoulder drape, bioluminescent accent thread.
what_it_says: I am here to be seen, and whoever I accompany has money and taste.
manufacturer: Velanthra Atelier (boutique synthetic fashion house, Circuit District)
story_hooks: The bioluminescent thread was sourced illegally from a TESSERA Genomics lab — it contains trace data.
The companion wore this the night a Spire power broker died; now the gown is evidence.

physical_description.visual_profile: A dramatic floor-length gown that celebrates synthetic form rather than masking it. The asymmetric neckline creates an avant-garde silhouette that frames augmented shoulders and collar structures. The deep aubergine mirrorsilk catches light like oil on water—shifting between plum, black, and iridescent copper depending on angle and movement. The cascading back split reveals spinal architecture gracefully, positioned as a design feature rather than accommodation. The removable voile drape adds ethereal movement and dimension.
physical_description.fit: Precision tailored to synthetic torsos with a column silhouette that flows rather than clings. The asymmetric shoulder cut accommodates wider servo arrays and interface ports without constraint. Accommodates spinal extensions up to 40cm beyond human norm, with strategic stretch panels along the back split. The gown hangs in perfect vertical tension, designed for beings with different weight distribution than organic humans.
physical_description.primary_material: Mirrorsilk (synthetic smart-fabric blend with photoreactive properties) for the gown; sheer voile overlay for the shoulder drape
physical_description.texture: The mirrorsilk has a liquid, almost oil-film quality—smooth but with subtle iridescence that shifts as you move. The bioluminescent threads create subtle ridged texture along seams. The voile is gossamer and weightless, translucent with a gentle hand-feel.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep aubergine as primary (approaching black in low light, vibrant purple in full light). Bioluminescent amber thread traces seams in warm gold tones that pulse gently and intensify with movement. Mirrorsilk creates copper and teal highlights depending on light source.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic clasps secure the shoulder drape (easily removed for reconfiguration). The gown itself is a seamless wrap with a hidden compression-fit waistband designed for synthetic chassis stability.
distinctive_features: Bioluminescent seam-tracing in warm amber that responds to movement
Asymmetric shoulder geometry designed for synthetic augmentation ratios
Cascading back split that exposes spinal interface aesthetically
Removable magnetic-clasp shoulder drape in voile
Precision tailoring for non-human torso proportions
No visible closures—seamless and integrated design
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 luxury. Velanthra Atelier is a boutique house catering to wealthy synthetic enthusiasts and augmented elite in the Circuit District. This is haute couture pricing (estimated Φ8,000-12,000 range).
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by those who celebrate their augmentation rather than hide it. Appeals to Circuit District glitterati, synthetic-fashion forward corpo executives, and those who view their chassis as an extension of personal identity and art. Signals wealth, aesthetic consciousness, and comfort with visible synthetic form.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine and meticulously maintained. Velanthra pieces are treated as investment garments. The bioluminescent threads are regularly recharged via inductive panels at boutique maintenance studios. Typically appears fresh and luminous on the wearer.
